auditNotes: The 14 input files include 12 supported image files plus one malformed PNG and one unsupported GIF extension probe.
The exact expected output hashes are immutable data; runtime timestamps, host metadata and JSON report timestamps differ across runs and are provenance only.
Approval status must be changed by an independent human reviewer in a separately reviewed commit; no self-approval is recorded.

Three detailed diagnostic log files (MSBuild binary log, MSBuild text log, NuGet restore log) were not copied into Git; their original artifact hashes are recorded per run. The 72 input/pixel observations and JSON/text reports/environment manifests are preserved.
